name: VACCINE STORAGE REFRIGERATOR
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Vaccine Storage Refrigerator is designed for highly safe storage of vaccines, medicines, and insulin between 2°C to 8°C. It features a smart undercounter design, full-length double layered toughened glass door with frost-free feature, anti-condensation, and an in-built tamper-proof data recording facility.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Vaccine Storage Refrigerator operates on precision microprocessor-controlled forced-air cooling to maintain a stable 2°C to 8°C environment compliant with DIN 58345. It uses R600a refrigerant and frost-free circulation to prevent temperature stratification and condensation, ensuring vaccines, insulin, and temperature-sensitive biological reagents retain potency. Doctors rely on it for vaccine and insulin storage; B.Sc/M.Sc students and PhD researchers use it for enzyme reagents, serological test kits, and microbiological media; chemists store heat-labile standards and buffer solutions. Tamper-proof data logging records temperature excursions, power failures, and door openings for GLP/GMP traceability.
sop: Ensure the door seal and interior are clean and dry; connect the unit to a 220V 50Hz supply and switch it ON.
Allow the refrigerator to run empty until the display stabilizes and confirms the internal temperature is within 2°C to 8°C before loading any vaccines or medicines.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter, e.g., 5°C for vaccine storage.
Press 'SET' again to lock the value.
Wait at least 30 minutes for temperature stabilization and verify the displayed value against a calibrated independent thermometer.
Load vaccines, insulin, or biological reagents with adequate spacing; avoid overloading and never block internal air vents.
Close the door fully, engage the lock, and record the temperature reading in the daily log or download it via the USB data recording port.
Enable visual and audible alarms for low/high temperature, door open, sensor failure, and power failure; respond immediately if they activate.

Safety Warning: Do not store flammable solvents, corrosive chemicals, or unsealed infectious materials in this refrigerator; if temperature exceeds 2°C to 8°C or a power failure occurs, quarantine contents and consult a pharmacist or supervisor before use.
features: Small undercounter size that occupies low space
Tamper-proof data recording & storage via USB
Visual and audible low/high temperature & power failure alarms
Fully length frost free toughened glass door with lock & key

specifications.Data Recording: Tamper-proof temperature & event recording with USB port
specifications.Alarms: Temperature low & high, sensor failure, power failure, door open, low battery
